proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration lifecycle: new config fields are validated/defaulted, overridden from env, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks (including nChannelsPerNetPeer, graphUsageMode, maxP2pPeers, and placeholder acceptance of nvlinkCentricSched/numRmaCtx). Enqueue is additionally needed because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream graph/uncaptured acquire-release and capture detection behavior used by enqueue/channel paths. Device-topology is additionally needed because P2P channel-per-peer computation in topology paths now uses nChannelsPerNetPeer and maxP2pPeers to cap/tune per-peer channel allocation.
